verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. The pack documents no user-facing bulk export, no open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), and no account-exit or offboarding process. The CRM API only gives developers access to client data, which is a building block for building an export, not an export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
